items.title: AppLovin (APP) Stock Still Looks Cheap After Sharp Pullback
items.summary: AppLovin has swung from a very large gain of roughly 7x over three years to a sharp pullback this week, which puts fresh attention on whether its current share price squares with the cash the business can generate. With traders weighing potential deals and new shareholders coming in, the question is how much of AppLovin’s future cash flows are already baked into the US$348.29 price at the last close. items.title: The App Paradigm Will “Slowly, if Not Quickly, Dissipate,” Says Mark Gurman. That’s a Problem for Apple
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloomberg’s Mark Gurman said the app paradigm will “slowly, if not quickly, dissipate” as AI calls for a new kind of operating system. Alphabet’s Gemini sits under Apple’s rebuilt AI models, while AppLovin’s install-driven ad business needs apps to last.

items.title: AppLovin vs. Reddit: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: AppLovin is growing fast and is highly profitable, but its stock has been volatile. Reddit is profitable and still growing, but Google's AI search is sending it fewer visitors.
